snippet.title: Maya Le Tissier Exclusive | Inside Carrington: S2 Ep 9
snippet.description:
Manchester United Women captain Maya Le Tissier joins the Inside Carrington podcast for an in-depth conversation about leadership, resilience and her journey at the club.

Maya reflects on the team's start to the season, adapting to life under head coach Eva Olid and the responsibility that comes with captaining the Reds at such a young age. She also discusses her remarkable desire to play every game, her England ambitions and the motivation that continues to drive her every day.

We hear about her upbringing in Guernsey, the sacrifices made by her family to help her pursue a career in football, her superstitions before matches and what it meant to become captain of one of the biggest clubs in world football.
